posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Nataraja:

We know damage never happens simultaneously in this game, but the choosing of targets could. Wether it does or not is what's up to debate.

It does.

I think folks get the "simultaneously" thing confused in SotM. Just because things do not resolve simultaneously does not follow that nothing is simultaneous. Multiple effects that share the same trigger clause are considered to trigger simultaneously for instance (though we resolve them in the order of our choosing). Choosing targets can also happen simultaneously.

 

At the end of the villain turn, Kaagra Warfang deals the hero target with the highest hp H melee damage and the hero target with the second highest hp H minus 1 melee damage.
Let's also take a moment to just reflect on the fact that a single target can not both be the highest HP target and the second highest HP target at the same time. The game does not work that way.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Voss doesn't set a number of targets, neither does Kaargra.  They only require that a target meet the HP requirement to receive the damage.

They deal two instances of damage and do not require 2 targets be hit.

Siege Breaker hits the 2 targets with the highest HP, it cannot hit the same target twice.  

Whether or not the way the app currently looks like it works is the right way, or if it just doesn't matter yet because nothing can add a hero target mid villain damage right now, is to be seen.

It also could be programmed to account for new targets if they come into play and we just haven't seen that part work, it will never be such a common event that normal play should predicate it being resolved.

The main thing with the app right now is that it is important that the app determines the targets before dealing damage, because in a case like Siege Breaker, you can resolve damage against the second highest first, and then resolve damage against the highest.  So it must determine all valid targets before asking you which order to resolve in.

Even if a new target were added mid-damage, it would need to establish the current 2 highest hp targets before the first damage can be dealt
